view.title: C2b — Container drill-down: module wiring
view.caption: Which module owns which store/external edge? This view opens the APP box from C2a into its three modules; every rolled-up C2a edge reappears here at module grain. Canvas carries numbered edge refs only (1–23); the full claim lives in the edge-detail table keyed by number. This is the completeness reference for module-granular edges — the C2c–e overlays each repeat a subset of it.

nodes.label: Spring Boot modular monolith
detail: Module boundaries are the three clusters, NOT the blueprint's five pipeline stages (ADR 0005). Drawn opaque in C2a; opened at module grain in C2b and at component grain in C3a

nodes.label: conversion
detail: Conversion (cluster A) — 10 components incl. the Invoke Models seam

nodes.label: validation-certification
detail: Validation-certification (cluster B) — 5 components; static gate → device gate → classify → certify. Device-gate worker holds NO gateway credential (ADR 0013)

nodes.label: evidence
detail: Evidence (cluster C) — Preserve Provenance + metrics read model + auditor export

nodes.label: Review UI
detail: One authenticated internal API, no BFF (ADR 0008). SSO against the bank IdP is a HARD requirement, not a nice-to-have (M37). The ONLY UI in Phase 1

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
detail: WORKING ASSUMPTION (spine C3); dev/CI embedded or containerized, ephemeral-only (D1, M40). Schemas: conversion-state · lineage (append-only: app role INSERT/SELECT only, per-conversion hash chain, supersede-not-update — ADR 0012) · outbox+queue (bounded retries, dead-letter quarantine — M21) · judge-response cache (M27, CF7). No cross-lifecycle foreign keys (F4, ADR 0006)

nodes.label: test-execution process
detail: Test-execution process, spawned per device run. Separate OS process — shape committed NOW, sandbox technology weeks 3–8 (ADR 0013). NO long-lived credentials; single-run device session token; NEVER the gateway credential. Static capability rules gate entry (supplement, not the control)

nodes.label: secrets store
detail: Interim: CI secret store; the vault is named by the M33 controls-baseline read — PENDING. All credentials resolved by injected reference, never literals (M34/CF8)

nodes.label: object storage
detail: Evidence object storage behind an S3-compatible port (ADR 0011). Dev/CI: containerized MinIO; production BINDING PROBE-PENDING (week-0 platform probe; default = self-operated MinIO). Write-once / object-lock REQUIRED — ADR 0012's precondition, deployment-checked. Holds: classified artifacts + retention classes (M39) · canonicalized source snapshots (M15) · lineage chain anchors (ADR 0012). Envelope encryption + crypto-shredding before the first audit-retained artifact (ADR 0011 as amended)

nodes.label: Git
detail: Prompts / exemplars / golden set / test code; version identity is free

nodes.label: Perfecto device lab
detail: Same standing as the C1 node-detail table (E1/E2). INCUMBENT vendor — MSA on file, unread (E1); flows run on mock/synthetic data (E2); NOT covered by E3

nodes.label: Orchestrator AI gateway
detail: Same standing as the C1 node-detail table (E4). Model providers hosted INSIDE the bank — prompts never leave (E4); version-report contract UNVERIFIED (M5 held)

nodes.label: ALM Octane
detail: Same standing as the C1 node-detail table (E5). At BOTH ends of the pipeline (E5): ingest source AND publish target; asset-versioning UNVERIFIED (M7 held)

nodes.label: Excel / ALM-QC
detail: Same standing as the C1 node-detail table (E3/S9). File input originating from bank teams inside the network (E3/S9)

edges.detail: One authenticated internal API; SSO against bank IdP (M37)
Versioned export; itself an attributable lineage event (CF11)
Chain-head anchors at interval; a stale anchor is an alert (ADR 0012)
Perfecto + test-account credentials, by injected reference (M34)
Versioned assets (prompts / exemplars / golden set / test code)
Single-run device session token; expires with the run (ADR 0013)
Model calls (P2) via the Invoke Models seam
A3: publish certified assets (CF3); never a verdict precondition
Workbook file input; raw workbooks never enter Git (M35)
